issues.title: Broken External Spec References
issues.why: AC-22 and AC-23 reference external specs (spec/05, spec/27) and specific ACs (AC-SD-22, AC-T-28) that are not provided in the context, making concurrency and atomic-write rules unresolvable.
issues.fix: Incorporate the specific requirements of AC-SD-22 and AC-T-28 directly into the text of AC-22/23 or provide the referenced files.

issues.title: Missing Reference Images
issues.why: Multiple files (06, 20) reference a rendering pipeline diagram 'images/terminal-output-pipeline.mmd' which is not included in the module.
issues.fix: Include the Mermaid source for the terminal-output-pipeline diagram within the overview or a dedicated file.

issues.title: Stale Prose Contradictions
issues.why: Despite AC-21's '97-WINS' rule, files like 03 and 04 still contain 'os.Exit(1)' examples for misuse cases that the contract now mandates as Exit 2.
issues.fix: Perform a final regex sweep to replace 'os.Exit(1)' with 'os.Exit(int(exit.ExitMisuse))' in all code examples.
